claims.claim: Selected collection of books on marketing and sales
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows six spines including marketing and sales titles such as This Is Marketing, Sell Like Crazy, Guerrilla Marketing, and Sell or Be Sold.

claims.claim: Original copies, not photocopies or local reprints
claims.evidence: Spine photos cannot establish print origin; requires physical inspection of paper, binding, and publisher details.
Report lists interior writing as not shown; spine photos cannot reveal page contents.

risks.proof: Close-up photos of each cover and page edges, or a video flipping through all pages.

risks.risk: Whether books are new or used
risks.proof: Photos showing shrink-wrap, spine condition, and wear, or a timestamped video of the items.
Clear shot of each book showing whether a dust jacket is present.
Photo of the copyright page for each book.
risks.if_unproven: as the oldest or least desirable edition

risks.proof: Page-by-page photos or video of the interior of each book.
Seller declaration or video showing the storage environment.
risks.if_unproven: as exposed to smoke or pets

risks.risk: Whether the stack is the complete lot being sold
risks.proof: Wide shot of all items included in the sale.
risks.if_unproven: as only the six books shown

proof_requests: Close-up photos of each book's cover and spine condition
Photos of the copyright page of each book
Video flipping through the pages of each book to confirm no writing or damage
Confirmation of whether dust jackets are included
Wide shot showing the complete lot for sale
response.reason: The witness identifies six specific books by title, so the lot can be priced at its worst-case condition; claims about originality and interior condition cannot be verified from spine photos and are priced as unproven.
